prior_findings_disposition: HI-S2-1/HI-R3-1 fixed: 'SSH होस्ट कुंजी'. HI-S2-2 fixed in all nine keys; the translator's deviation from the literal fix is CORRECT and accepted: the perfective participle agrees with its head noun, so direct masculine singular takes 'पुश न किया गया' (count one arm '1 पुश न किया गया कमिट', subject 'पुश न किया गया एक कमिट', 'पुश न किया गया इतिहास … बहुत बड़ा है'), while oblique or plural takes 'पुश न किए गए' ('पुश न किए गए इतिहास में', 'पुश न किए गए एक कमिट में', other arm, warning/warning_leave plural). Applying 'किए गए' everywhere, as the fix text literally said, would have been ungrammatical in the direct singular slots.
